## Role and prompt

Write and run focused tests for ACCEPTANCE.md with a temporary SQLite database. Cover all ten stock datasets, exact fill results, rejected orders, session isolation and end bounds. Run the browser checklist if available. Record results and unrun checks in docs/TEST-RESULTS.md.

Use docs/SPEC.md as the source of truth. Report files changed, verification and blockers briefly.
